about: A free online editor for drawing database diagrams and turning them into SQL.

prs.title: Importing Postgres SQL keeps list-type columns
prs.broken: When importing Postgres SQL, columns that hold lists lost that. Some turned into a type Postgres does not have, so the exported SQL failed to run.
prs.changed: The importer now spots list columns and keeps them as lists, so the export writes them back correctly.
prs.matters: A Postgres schema can go in and come back out without breaking.
